title: Day spa, new business in an existing leased space, no construction — Rincón, coastal zone (zone X)
description: We are opening a day spa with three massage therapists in an existing leased commercial space near the beach in Rincón. The space is already finished; no construction or exterior work.

existing_building.evidence: existing leased commercial space, already finished

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction stated: RULE_0643/0644 need a construction / renovation project type.
FEMA zone X: RULE_0706 needs location.flood_zone.sfha.
Occupying an existing finished space with no physical work is not a coastal-zone development; RULE_0708 needs a construction or renovation basis.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-05 by the scenario loop: first spa scenario and first Rincón scenario. The spa health-permit card (RULE_0158, no statutory basis identified) is deliberately not asserted.
